  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 17:18:                                      
                                                                              
  Minimum-phase ordered target clarification: T composes each independent     
  ideal band magnitude with the unit phase of that final actual FIR stage. The
  accuracy criterion therefore qualifies sampled magnitude and the complete   
  cascade given actual stage phase, not equality to IIR/allpass phase and not 
  a new minimum-phase proof. Zero actual stage magnitude with nonzero target  
  still fails its magnitude check. Linear-phase target keeps positive ideal   
  magnitudes after removal of the actual N/2 stage delay. Existing minimum-   
  phase energy/latency tests remain unchanged.
